verdict.rationale: Filee's own llms.txt describes it as a free, open-source (MIT) file converter. A developer can therefore run real conversions, including through the documented CLI with JSON output, without ever paying, which goes beyond a trial or sandbox. missing for 10: an explicit statement that there are no usage caps or paid tiers, independent or hands-on corroboration of the free licensing.

support.subject: As a developer, a free tier, trial, or sandbox lets me test real conversions before paying

citations.quote: Filee is a free, open-source (MIT) file converter for Windows 10 and 11 and Linux (macOS preview).
"filee convert <files, wildcards or folders> --to <format>" (or "--preset <preset>") converts with the app's engines and presets
